run_EomtForUniversalSegmentationTester: run the EoMT model tester to generate config and input tensors for segmentation tests
test_EomtForUniversalSegmentationTest: test the EoMT universal segmentation model using the ModelTesterMixin and PipelineTesterMixin classes
test_EomtForUniversalSegmentationIntegra: test EoMT inference on pretrained models for panoptic, semantic, and instance segmentation tasks
run_test_inference: run EoMT panoptic segmentation inference on a COCO image with a pretrained large model
run_test_segmentation_pipeline: run the HuggingFace pipeline for panoptic segmentation using the EoMT model
